name: CBH Engineering Holding Berhad
overview: CBH Engineering Holding Berhad 于2026年4月完成收购土地及建筑物，用于扩大营运；其70%子公司CBH Infra Sdn. Bhd. 与GCG Electrical Engineering Sdn. Bhd. 签订地下公用设施工程合约，总额约RM2.63百万。公司亦派发单层中期股息每股RM0.0027。
overview_en: CBH Engineering Holding Berhad completed the acquisition of land and building in April 2026 to expand operations; its 70%-owned subsidiary CBH Infra Sdn. Bhd. entered into underground utilities works contracts with GCG Electrical Engineering Sdn. Bhd. totaling approximately RM2.63 million. The company also declared a single-tier interim dividend of RM0.0027 per ordinary share.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 完成土地及建筑物收购，作为营运扩张用途。
segments.note_en: Completed acquisition of land and building for operational expansion.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以买卖协议向SYSKON CORPORATION SDN BHD收购土地及建筑物，并于2026年4月9日完成。
actions.text_en: Acquired land and building from SYSKON CORPORATION SDN BHD via sale and purchase agreement, completed on 9 April 2026.

segments.name: 供应与地下公用设施
segments.note: 子公司CBH Infra Sdn. Bhd. 与GCG Electrical Engineering Sdn. Bhd. 签订地下公用设施工程合约。
segments.note_en: Subsidiary CBH Infra Sdn. Bhd. entered into underground utilities works contracts with GCG Electrical Engineering Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: CBH Infra Sdn. Bhd. 与GCG Electrical Engineering Sdn. Bhd. 签订地下公用设施工程合约，2026年1月10日至公告日期间总交易值为RM1,026,373.94。
actions.text_en: CBH Infra Sdn. Bhd. entered into underground utilities works contract with GCG Electrical Engineering Sdn. Bhd. with total transaction value of RM1,026,373.94 for the period from 10 January 2026 to the date of announcement.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: CBH Infra Sdn. Bhd. 与GCG Electrical Engineering Sdn. Bhd. 签订地下公用设施工程合约，总值RM1,603,211.40。
actions.text_en: CBH Infra Sdn. Bhd. entered into underground utilities works contract with GCG Electrical Engineering Sdn. Bhd. for a total value of RM1,603,211.40.
